title: Fix Admin Panel Katha errors, add MP3 upload, fix Community Posts visibility, and fix TTS

requirements.text: Fix the Admin Panel error that occurs when adding a new Katha (religious story). The backend `addKatha` or equivalent function should correctly accept and persist all required fields without throwing errors. Validate that the Motoko actor's katha creation logic handles all field types properly and that the frontend form submits correct data types matching the backend interface.

quotes: Admin Panel fix — कथाएं add करते समय जो error आता था वो fix होगा
phele m kathayen add krta to error aa jata or add nahi hoti usse bhi thik kro

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can fill out the Katha form in the Admin Panel and submit without any error
The submitted Katha appears in the backend and is retrievable from the Kathayen listing page
No console errors or failure messages when adding a new Katha

requirements.text: Add an MP3 file upload field in the Admin Panel's Katha creation/edit form. The admin should be able to upload an MP3 audio file along with each Katha. The MP3 binary data should be stored in the backend (as a Blob/chunk) associated with the Katha record. The backend Katha data model should include an optional `audioBlob` or `audioData` field to store the uploaded MP3 bytes.

quotes: admin khud MP3 audio file upload kar sake katha ke saath
ek feature or add kro ki kathayen upload krte time khud admin hi mp3 upload krega

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel Katha form includes an MP3 file upload input
After upload, the MP3 is stored in the backend associated with the Katha
The Katha record indicates whether audio is available

requirements.text: Add an audio player ('सुनें' / Listen button) on the public-facing Katha detail page (`KathaDetail.tsx`). When a Katha has an associated MP3 uploaded by the admin, the 'सुनें' button should appear and play that audio when clicked. Use an HTML5 audio player or a styled play/pause control that streams or loads the MP3 blob from the backend.

quotes: us katha me sun ne wale option pr click krke sun sakte hai
Public side par Audio Player — 'सुनें' button se MP3 play hoga

acceptanceCriteria: A 'सुनें' (Listen) button is visible on the Katha detail page only when an MP3 is associated with that Katha
Clicking the button plays the uploaded MP3 audio
User can pause and resume playback
If no MP3 is uploaded, the button is hidden or disabled

requirements.text: Fix Community Posts so that all logged-in users can see all approved posts and also create new posts. The Community page (`Community.tsx`) should display a YouTube-style feed of all posts to any authenticated user. Non-logged-in users should not be able to view or create posts. Fix any backend query or approval-status filter that may be preventing posts from appearing to regular users.

quotes: community post nahi ho rahi hai or na public ko dikh rahi hai
Community Posts fix — Posts sabhi logged-in users ko dikhein aur YouTube jaisa feed ho
Login ke baad hi community posts dekh aur upload kar sakte hain

acceptanceCriteria: Logged-in users can see all community posts in a feed-style layout
Logged-in users can create and submit new community posts
Posts submitted by users appear in the feed after submission
Unauthenticated users are shown a login prompt and cannot view or create posts
The feed visually resembles a YouTube/social feed with post cards showing author, content, and media

requirements.text: Fix the Text-to-Speech (TTS) functionality in the production/downloaded app. The `useSpeechNarration` hook currently uses the Web Speech API which may not work reliably in installed PWA or certain browsers. Ensure TTS works in production by: (1) verifying the speech synthesis voices are loaded before speaking, (2) adding a user-gesture-triggered warm-up, (3) handling the case where `speechSynthesis` is cancelled silently in background tabs or PWA mode with a retry/resume mechanism.

quotes: tts in downloaded app not working
TTS fix — Text-to-Speech sahi se kaam karega

acceptanceCriteria: TTS plays correctly when user taps the narration/play button in the production/installed app
TTS works on Katha detail page and other pages that use `useSpeechNarration`
TTS does not silently fail — if unavailable, a clear message or fallback is shown
TTS resumes or restarts if interrupted by background/foreground switch in PWA mode

constraints: Do not rebuild the app from scratch — only modify the existing codebase
Keep the existing login system (Internet Identity + admin username/password) unchanged
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor file
nonGoals: Rebuilding or redesigning the entire application
Changing the authentication system or login flow
Adding new pages or navigation items beyond what is described
External audio hosting or CDN integration — MP3 stored in backend blob storage only
